before_execution: Review applicable account/use conditions and intended outputs
Freeze the new acquisition scope and protocol separately from historical WARIS
Define whether collection is a bounded page sample or a complete frame
Do not replace missing historical dates or receipts with the new acquisition
receipt_fields_for_an_actual_future_exec: UTC request start and response completion
Endpoint and explicit nonsecret query parameters
HTTP status and allowlisted nonsecret response metadata
Private response-body hash and private normalized-file hash, distinguished
Rows returned, total if supplied, page/cursor and termination evidence
Duplicate identifiers and exclusion/mapping counts without public identifiers
Observation date bounds separately from acquisition UTC
Applicable terms snapshot locator/hash and account-context evidence reference
Coverage limitations, study protocol hash and source-separation posture
never_record_or_bundle: raw event records in public releases
